summary: This is a hosts file configuration that maps IP addresses to human-readable domain names. Line 1 sets up the standard localhost mapping, and line 3 creates a custom local domain alias so you can access something running on your own machine by typing 'kingsbridge' instead of an IP address.

explanations.2: This comment tells a documentation tool (like Docusaurus) to highlight the next line visually, usually to draw attention to that specific mapping.
explanations.3: This line tells your computer that whenever you try to connect to 'kingsbridge', route that request to 127.0.0.1 (your own machine), so you can test a local service using a domain name instead of localhost.
